title: Privacy Policy

sections.body:
theworldofai.org (the "Website") is published by SRJ Consulting & Services LLC ("SRJ", "we", "us", "our"), a Texas limited liability company with its principal place of business at 13054 Cinderella Lane, Frisco, TX 75035-5194, United States. SRJ is the "controller" of personal information collected through the Website under European and United Kingdom law, and the "business" that collects personal information under the California Consumer Privacy Act as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act (together, the "CCPA/CPRA").

This Policy is a companion to our Terms of Use and Disclaimer, each incorporated by reference.

This Policy covers information collected through this Website, its public API endpoints, and our newsletter. It does not apply to third-party websites linked from the Website, which are governed by their own policies, nor to srjconsultingservices.com, which has its own privacy policy.

Information you provide. The Website has no account system and no login. If you subscribe to our newsletter, we collect your email address and any name you provide. If you email us, we receive the content of your message and your email address.

Information collected automatically. When you visit, our infrastructure and service providers collect technical information including your IP address, browser type and version, device type, operating system, language preference, referring website, pages viewed, links clicked, on-site search terms, session duration, and the dates and times of your visits. This is used for analytics, performance, security, and abuse detection.

Information from third parties. We may receive aggregated reports from our analytics, advertising, and newsletter providers, such as subscription events and email engagement metrics.

We use a small number of cookies and similar technologies, grouped as follows:

  • Strictly necessary. Set by our content delivery network for security, bot management, and site delivery. These cannot be switched off.
  • Analytics. Google Analytics 4, used to measure traffic and understand which pages are useful. Loaded only where you consent.
  • Advertising. Where advertising appears on the Website, it is delivered by Google and its certified partners, who may set cookies or read device identifiers to serve and measure ads. Loaded only where you consent.

We operate Google Consent Mode v2. Until you make a choice, analytics and advertising storage are denied by default. You may change or withdraw your choice at any time using the cookie preferences control on the Website.

The Website is supported in part by advertising. Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits to this or other websites. Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to you based on your visits to this and other sites on the internet.

You may opt out of personalized advertising by Google at Google Ads Settings, and out of third-party vendor personalization at optout.aboutads.info. Declining advertising consent on this Website does not remove ads; it limits their personalization.

For CCPA/CPRA purposes, delivering personalized advertising may constitute "sharing" personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising. We do not sell personal information for money. California residents may opt out of sharing using the cookie preferences control or by emailing us at the address in Section 12.

• To operate, secure, monitor, and improve the Website and its API;
  • To measure traffic and understand which content is useful;
  • To deliver and measure our newsletter to subscribers who opted in;
  • To display and measure advertising, subject to your consent;
  • To detect, investigate, and prevent fraud, abuse, and security incidents;
  • To comply with legal obligations and enforce our Terms of Use.

Consent for analytics cookies, advertising cookies, and newsletter subscription. Legitimate interests for operating and securing the Website and preventing abuse. Legal obligation where processing is required by law. You may withdraw consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of prior processing.

We disclose personal information only to service providers who process it on our behalf under contract, including our content delivery and hosting provider, our analytics provider, our advertising provider, and our newsletter platform; when required by law, subpoena, or legal process, or to protect rights, property, or safety; and in connection with a merger, financing, or sale of assets, subject to this Policy.

Server and security logs are retained for up to 30 days. Analytics data is retained for up to 14 months. Newsletter subscriber email addresses are retained while you remain subscribed; on unsubscribe we keep a suppression record containing only your email address and the fact of unsubscribe, so that we can honor your request. Email correspondence is retained for as long as needed to handle your inquiry.

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or receive a portable copy of your personal information, to opt out of sale, sharing, or targeted advertising, to limit use of sensitive personal information, and to appeal a denial. Residents of the EEA and UK may also object to or restrict processing and lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. Texas residents have equivalent rights under the Texas Data Privacy and Security Act.

To exercise a right, email us with the subject line "Privacy Rights Request" and tell us the right you are exercising, the email address associated with your information, and your state or country of residence. We will respond within the period required by applicable law. We will not discriminate against you for exercising a right.

The Website is intended for a general adult audience and is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them. If you believe a child has provided us information, contact us and we will delete it.
SRJ Consulting & Services LLC, 13054 Cinderella Lane, Frisco, TX 75035-5194, United States. Email: info@srjconsultingservices.com.
We may update this Policy. The date at the top reflects the most recent change, and material changes will be noted on the Website.
